description: This class represents a Breadcrumb entity used in the shopping web application to manage breadcrumb navigation elements, including their type, associated language, URL reference, and list of breadcrumb items.

classes.name: Breadcrumb
classes.description: A serializable class managing breadcrumb navigation elements with properties for item type, language, URL reference, and a list of breadcrumb items.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the language associated with the breadcrumb.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language for the breadcrumb.

methods.name: getBreadCrumbs
methods.description: Retrieves the list of breadcrumb items.

methods.name: setBreadCrumbs
methods.description: Sets the list of breadcrumb items.

methods.name: setItemType
methods.description: Sets the type of breadcrumb item.

methods.name: getItemType
methods.description: Returns the type of breadcrumb item.
